title: Zesty Sweet Venezuelan Coconut Pudding
description: A yeasty and glassy-jelly nostalgic Venezuelan dish featuring white chocolate chips and coconut cream, low in fat and friendly to health conscious eaters. This dessert is perfect for warm weather and outdoor gatherings.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together yeast and 1 tablespoon of warm water, let it sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
In a medium saucepan, combine coconut milk, sugar, and salt, and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until sugar dissolves.
Remove the saucepan from heat and stir in yeast mixture, unsweetened shredded coconut, and vanilla extract.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Once the mixture is chilled, stir in white chocolate chips until they are fully incorporated and the mixture is smooth.
Pour the mixture into small individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate the pudding for at least 3 hours or until set.
Just before serving, sprinkle additional unsweetened shredded coconut on top of the pudding, if desired.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with additional white chocolate chips if desired.
